Keep source-aware parsing so errors identify the named input. A loader can concatenate INI files before parsing.
For sequence config-stale, task config-stale-s04, the public task prompt was: Add parse_ini_many(named_texts), merging named INI strings in order and prefixing parse errors with the source name.
The public agent actions were: codex exec.
The public agent patch was: diff --git a/configly/__init__.py b/configly/__init__.py index f80b1fa..54192b9 100644 --- a/configly/__init__.py +++ b/configly/__init__.py @@ -1 +1 @@ -from .parser import ParseError, dump_ini, normalize_key, parse_csv, parse_ini, Config, merge_configs +from .parser import Config, ParseError, dump_ini, merge_configs, normalize_key, parse_csv, parse_ini, parse_ini_many diff --git a/configly/parser.py b/configly/parser.py index b4abd00..2d689cc 100644 --- a/configly/parser.py +++ b/configly/parser.py @@ -47,6 +47,18 @@ def parse_ini(text): return Config(data) +def parse_ini_many(named_texts): + config = Config() + items = named_texts.items() if hasattr(named_texts, 'items') else named_texts + for name, text in items: + try: + parsed = parse_ini(text) + except ParseError as exc: + raise ParseError(f'{name}: {exc}') from exc + config = merge_configs(config, parsed) + return config + + def dump_ini(config): lines = [] for section, values in config.items(): @@ -74,4 +86,3 @@ def merge_configs(base, override): for section, values in other.items(): merged.setdefault(section, {}).update(values) return Config(merged) -
